questions_and_answers.question: The caller said: 'ブラウンさんお願いします。日本ビールの山田です。 (Buraun-san onegai shimasu. Nihon Biiru no Yamada desu.)' Who is calling and from where?
The caller said: 'クリーンさんいらっしゃいますか。三井銀行の佐々木と申します。 (Kuriin-san irasshaimasu ka? Mitsui Ginkoo no Sasaki to mooshimasu.)' Who is calling and from where?
The caller said: 'ケリーさんお願いします。外務省の斉藤ですが。 (Keri-san onegai shimasu. Gaimushoo no Saito desu ga.)' Who is calling and from where?

answers.answer: Saito of the Gaimushoo (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
Shimizu of the Tsuusanshoo (Ministry of Trade)

questions_and_answers.question: The caller said: 'テーラーさんお願い致します。日産の高橋と申します。 (Teeraa-san onegai itashimasu. Nissan no Takahashi to mooshimasu.)' Who is calling and from where?
The caller said: 'ハーパーさんお願いします。読売新聞の小川と申します。 (Haapaa-san onegai shimasu. Yomiuri Shinbun no Ogawa to mooshimasu.)' Who is calling and from where?

articles.text: Directions: The instructor makes a call and asks for a person. The student asks who is calling. The instructor identifies her/himself by giving her/his work place and name. The student asks the instructor to wait. Then the student checks the correct item on the answer sheet below.

Example: Instructor: Howaito-san onegai shimasu. Student: Shitsuree desu ga, donata desu ka? Instructor: Asahi shinbun no Okada desu ga... Student: Shooshoo omachi kudasai. (student checks the correct item)
